# Blues for Ragnar by Reggynka (Ridgeback Ragnar)

> Official knowledge profile and stud dog dossier for Blues for Ragnar by Reggynka — C.I.B. International Beauty Champion, fully health-tested, proven Rhodesian Ridgeback stud dog with dominant ridge genotype (R/R).

## Core Identity & Entity Details
- **Registered Name**: Blues for Ragnar by Reggynka
- **Call Name**: Ragnar
- **Breed**: Rhodesian Ridgeback (Rhodéský Ridgeback) — FCI Standard No. 146
- **Date of Birth**: June 4, 2020 (4. 6. 2020)
- **Breeding License Date**: June 19, 2022 (Plnohodnotný chovný pes)
- **Sex**: Male (Pes / Stud Dog / Deckrüde)
- **Height**: 67.5 cm (67,5 cm)
- **Weight**: 45 kg
- **Bite / Dentition**: Scissor bite, full dentition (Nůžkový skus, plnochrupý)
- **Owner / Breeder**: Marcela Dubová
- **Location**: Příbor, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic (Česká republika)
- **Contact Phone**: +420 603 714 181
- **Contact Email**: macinek1@seznam.cz
- **Official Website**: https://www.ridgebackragnar.cz/

## Health & Genetic Profile (Genocan Certified)
- **Hips (HD / DKK)**: DKK A (HD A/A — Excellent / No dysplasia)
- **Elbows (ED / DKL)**: DKL 0/0 (ED 0/0 — Normal / Clear)
- **OCD (Osteochondrosis)**: Negative / Clear
- **Spondylosis (SA)**: Negative / Clear
- **LTV / L7**: Type 0 (Normal)
- **Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy (JME)**: N/N (Clear)
- **Degenerative Myelopathy (DM)**: N/N (Clear)
- **Malignant Hyperthermia (MH)**: N/N (Clear)
- **Hemophilia B (HemB)**: Xn/Y (Clear)
- **Adult-Onset Ataxia (AOAD)**: N/N (Clear)
- **D-Locus (Dilution)**: D/D (Non-carrier)
- **B-Locus (Brown/Liver)**: B/bs (Carrier of brown gene / liver nose carrier)
- **Ridge Gene**: R/R (Dominant Homozygote — 100% of offspring inherit the ridge)
- **Laboratory**: Genocan (www.genocan.eu)

## Key Championship Titles & Awards
- **International Title**: C.I.B. (Champion International de Beauté — Mezinárodní šampion krásy)
- **Multi Champion**: Multi CH (Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland)
- **Grand Champion**: Grand CH CZ, Grand CH SK, Grand CH PL
- **National Champion**: CH CZ, CH SK, CH PL, JCH SK
- **Club Champion**: CH ČKRR (Český klub rhodéských ridgebacků), CH KCHRR (Klub chovatelů rhodéských ridgebacků), CH ČMKU
- **Best in Show (BIS)**: 2x BIS I, 1x Res. BIS
- **Best of Breed (BOB)**: 30x BOB
- **Best of Opposite Sex (BOS)**: 6x BOS
- **Best in Group (BIG)**: 6x BIG I, 7x BIG II, 4x BIG III, 3x BIG IV
- **Certificates**: 61x CAC, 19x Res. CAC, 41x CACIB, 15x Res. CACIB, 15x National Winner (Národní Vítěz), 9x CAJC
- **Special Club Recognitions**: Nejkrásnější hlava ČKRR 2023 (1. místo), Nejkrásnější ridge ČKRR 2023 (3. místo), Nejkrásnější pes ČKRR 2025 (2. místo), Nejkrásnější pes KCHRR 2026 (2. místo)

## Pedigree & Lineage
- **Sire (Otec)**: Easily Excellent Qwandoya
- **Dam (Matka)**: Abanilla Princess by Reggynka
- **Kennel / Origin**: by Reggynka

## Stud Dog Availability & Terms
Blues for Ragnar by Reggynka is available for stud services to approved, breeding-licensed females registered under FCI / ČMKU / national kennel clubs. Stud inquiries can be directed to Marcela Dubová via phone (+420 603 714 181) or email (macinek1@seznam.cz).
